name: Lifesense
description: An open connection to Lifesense A2/A3 scales, including the Philips DL8780. Read measurements, understand the handshake, and use the library in your own application.
capabilities: Parsers for A2 and A3 weight notifications.
Decode the scale’s measurement and append packets.
A reusable handshake with persistent pairing state.
Assign readings to people and keep them on your own hardware.
tested: Checked against a live Philips DL8780. Other scales that speak the same Lifesense A2/A3 protocol may work, but are not all tested.
limits: Body composition values in the Bathroom Hub are calculated per person. They are estimates, not medical measurements.
code:
from openble.lifesense.packets import parse_a3_weight

reading = parse_a3_weight(bytes.fromhex(
    "1f 16 26 00 fe 89 50 91 1f 00 00 00 00 17 13 00 ff 01 19 00"
))
print(reading["weight_kg"])  # 97.5
next: Run the Bathroom Hub, or use the library with your own Bluetooth transport.
